answer: Require each agent to post a bond that is locked before it can earn rewards, and release it only after a random, delayed audit of its work. Auditors sample claims across tasks and slash the bond for fabricated contributions, while honest agents recover it. A sybil attacker must therefore lock substantial capital in every fake identity and risks losing it; splitting one identity into many does not multiply cheap influence. Even cedar, willow, and shale agents face the same bond and audit rules.
